messages:
alex: Heads-up — after yesterday's routing quota tweak I see the dashboard charts stall for ~3s when opening a project. Happens on canary and a few EU users reported it. :eyes:

maria: saw that too. Client heap climbs then main thread blocks. Grabbed a heap snapshot and a flame chart. link: https://internal.artifacts/heap/171234.zip

jordan: can you paste the exact change? was it routing.weight adjustments or the quota window?

alex: we bumped route_quota.window_ms from 500 -> 1200 and lowered routing.weight for low-priority routes. config diff:
```json
{ "route_quota": { "window_ms": 1200 }, "routing": { "weights": { "metrics": 0.6, "legacy": 0.1 } } }
```

maria: interesting — flame shows a lot of time in `telemetryAggregator.flush()` and `serializeMetricBatch()`. main thread spikes during first render when charts hydrate.

jordan: that smells like duplicate dynamic imports causing extra telemetry subscribe loops. If chunks are loaded twice we register two samplers and they both stringify big payloads.

alex: i can repro with slow network throttling. network waterfall shows vendor chunk downloaded 2x for the same route request.

sam: deploy-bot: canary deployment 2024-04-05T03:12 triggered for app-console (rev: r-2024-04-05-76).

maria: @sam can you roll the canary back to before the routing tweak for a quick check? would confirm config is the trigger.

sam: rolling back now. give me a ping if you want me to hold canary. :thumbsup:

jordan: quick local test — repro by toggling `enableChunkAffinity = false` in client config. When affinity off, chunks de-dupe fine. With affinity on + longer quota window, affinity mapping misaligns and dynamic import requests end up creating two in-flight fetches for the same split.

alex: summary: route_quota window increase -> affinity mapping retention longer -> duplicate chunk fetches -> duplicate telemetry samplers -> main-thread JSON.stringify burst -> chart hydration stall.

maria: workaround: throttle telemetry flush to background and dedupe sampler registrations. I'll file a small patch to guard sampler init: `if (sampler.isRegistered) return` and queue flush via requestIdleCallback.

jordan: also add a short-term mitigation in routing logic: if chunk fetch already in progress, reuse promise instead of starting another fetch. small change and should stop duplication.

sam: rollback completed — canary back to r-2024-04-04-11. Monitoring UX now.

alex: after rollback I no longer repro the 3s stall. EU users reporting baseline restored. good call.

maria: i'm opening PRs: one for sampler guard + idle flush, one for fetch dedupe. linking after CI: https://internal.github/repo/pr/4212 and /pr/4213

jordan: we should also add a unit/integration test that simulates overlapping dynamic imports with changed routing windows so this doesn't regress again.

alex: agreed. i'll add an e2e canary test step that runs in a slow-net simulate job. thanks all. :raised_hands:
